independent.precision_note: Decimal.from_float reconstructs binary values; printed decimal tables are not authority.

policy.absolute_tolerance_rule: sum(0.5*ulp(q_i)) e, round-to-nearest source representation envelope
policy.justification: Binary64 representation and standard forward error bound for finite floating-point summation (Higham, Accuracy and Stability of Numerical Algorithms, 2nd ed., section 3.1). Residual is in source values, not solely accumulation error. Native constrained float64 fit plus rounding is numerically consistent when within this declared envelope; no chemical accuracy inferred.
policy.output_precision: lossless native NPY binary64; JSON/hex roundtrip; no rounded table authority
policy.summation_method: exact binary Fraction decision; math.fsum compensated reduction; Decimal.from_float cross-check
